meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化配置 Microsoft Entra 身份蓝图和令牌交换
copy.tagline_en: Automate Microsoft Entra identity blueprint provisioning and token exchange
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identities and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange

howto.what: 该技能让Claude通过Microsoft Graph API创建和管理Entra Agent身份(Blueprint、BlueprintPrincipal、按实例Agent Identity),并配置OAuth 2.0令牌交换(fmi_path、OBO、跨租户)及Entra SDK sidecar。
howto.when: 当你要求配置Entra Agent Identity相关资源(Blueprint、BlueprintPrincipal、按实例Agent Identity)或代理OAuth令牌交换(fmi_path、OBO、跨租户)时触发。

say.note: 必须显式创建,否则报错。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude provision and manage Microsoft Entra Agent identities via Microsoft Graph: create an Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, and per-instance Agent Identities, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) plus the Entra SDK sidecar.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you request provisioning of Entra Agent Identity resources (Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, per-instance Agent Identity) or agent OAuth token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant).

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity Blueprint with the current user as sponsor.
say_en.note: Calls Graph API to create and returns appId.

say_en.text: Create a BlueprintPrincipal for this Blueprint.
say_en.note: Must be created explicitly or it errors.

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity for agent-1 and grant User.Read.All.
say_en.note: Grants are per Agent Identity, not BlueprintPrincipal.
